$comment: Benchmark prompts: 10 per shipped genre, alternating so --limit N covers both genres. Each row is graded by the full gate set.

prompts.prompt: A tight cave platformer about a lantern-carrying mole who dashes through crumbling tunnels, with coins to collect and beetles to stomp.
A frantic arena survivors game where a lighthouse keeper fends off waves of sea ghosts for one minute, collecting lantern oil to level up.
A snowy mountain platformer: short, precise jumps between icy ledges, spikes at the bottom of every pit, a hopping yeti cub as the enemy.
Survive sixty seconds in a haunted library as a candle spirit; books fly at you in rings, and every page you burn makes your flame hit harder.
A sewer-run platformer with a frog courier: hop over sludge pits, stomp rats, collect stamps, three levels that teach jump, dash and stomp in order.
An arena survivors game set on a tiny asteroid; rock crabs swarm from the edges and the miner's drill auto-attacks the nearest one.
A six-level ruins platformer for a tomb thief: traps are always visible, walkers patrol narrow ledges, turrets guard the gold, dashes cross wide gaps.
A cozy-looking but tough survivors run in a bee garden: wasps come in waves, nectar levels you up, brutes arrive late.
A clockwork factory platformer where a wind-up toy soldier marches right, hops gears, stomps rust bugs and reaches the exit before winding down.
Hold the campfire: a ranger auto-fires arrows at wolves that circle in from the dark for one minute; pick up embers to level up.
A forgiving first platformer for kids: a round bird hops across mushroom tops, collects seeds and bops sleepy slugs; nothing is hidden, deaths are rare.
A neon arena where a maintenance drone repels rogue cleaner bots; waves get denser, the drone's zapper range grows with every chip collected.
Volcano escape: lava pits with spikes, rising difficulty across three levels, hopping magma imps, coins as salvaged gems.
A pocket-sized survivors game about a gardener and an endless stream of hungry snails; harvest glowing seeds to level up your spade.
A sky-island platformer: one-way cloud platforms, long dashes, walkers on every island, six levels with a gentle ramp.
A medium survivors run in a flooded subway: rats in rings, a brute rat late, oil cans as xp; the player's wrench auto-swings.
A haunted mansion platformer where a tiny ghost hunter jumps bookshelves, stomps spider walkers and collects keys; short, readable, fair.
One minute on a frozen lake: penguin chef versus swarms of hungry gulls, fish as xp, waves from the edges then rings.
A desert canyon platformer: dash across wide crevices with spikes below, stomp scorpion walkers, grab water drops, three levels.
A junkyard survivors arena where a magnet robot pulls in scrap (xp) while crushing waves of rust mites that chase it.
A mythic dungeon crawl: a torch-bearer clears ember-lit halls room by room, swinging a heavy blade at skeleton grunts and dodging archers behind pillars.
A cartoon kitchen brawl: a chef with a frying pan clears pantry rooms of rushing rats and jar-throwing imps; the door opens when the room is clean.
A four-floor crypt where a knight fights grunts in tight rooms, archers across long halls and a brute at the bottom; dashes cross arrow lanes.
A neon arcade dungeon: a janitor robot sweeps through rooms of malfunctioning bots with a mop swing, parrying laser bolts.
